description: This source file implements authentication support for the GSASL (Gnu SASL) protocol within the curl project, specifically for SCRAM-SHA-1 authentication. It contains functions to initialize, support, start, process tokens, and clean up GSASL-related data structures for secure authentication.

methods.name: bool Curl_auth_gsasl_is_supported(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * mech,struct gsasldata * gsasl)
methods.description: Checks if the specified mechanism is supported by initializing GSASL and starting a client with the mechanism.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_gsasl_start(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * userp,const char * passwdp,struct gsasldata * gsasl)
methods.description: Sets authentication properties (user and password) for the GSASL client.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_gsasl_token(struct Curl_easy * data,const struct bufref * chlg,struct gsasldata * gsasl,struct bufref * out)
methods.description: Processes a challenge received from the server to generate a response token.

methods.name: void Curl_auth_gsasl_cleanup(struct gsasldata * gsasl)
methods.description: Cleans up GSASL resources by finishing the client and done contexts.
